payload.disambiguation_note: Use this subject for the dicyclic group of order 12, not for alternate conventions where Dic_n denotes a group of order 4n.
payload.scope_note: The finite dicyclic group of order 12 with presentation <a,x | a^6=1, x^2=a^3, x a x^-1=a^-1>. It is the finite group input for the untwisted D(Dic_12) Drinfeld double MTC subject.
upstream_review_hints: A future ontology may introduce a finite-group subject kind; migrate this mathematical-object subject append-only if that happens.
The disambiguation note is important because dicyclic group notation varies across sources.
